name: authichain-trust-engine
description: Verification/trust layer for the agentic economy. Agents verify product authenticity, classify verticals, and pay per verification via x402.

tools.name: verify_authenticity
tools.description: Verify a product by AuthiChain certificate number.

tools.name: mint_certificate
tools.description: Initiate a trust certificate mint (5-agent consensus).

tools.name: classify_product
tools.description: Classify a product into an industry vertical + suggested workflow.

tools.name: verify_sovereign_deal
tools.description: Verify a sovereign deal by TrueMark ID.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Discover metered verification price + subscription plans.

tools.name: verify_paid
tools.description: Pay-per-call verification via x402 (returns 402 requirements until paid).
